title: [FI] Obsolete unused 'Print on Invoice' VAT setting
summary: The unused 'Print on Invoice' VAT field on VAT posting groups is marked obsolete on the pending-to-removed cycle, with no behavioral impact until final removal in a future version.
key_points: Field 13400 marked as Pending obsolete on VAT Business Posting Group (323) and VAT Product Posting Group (324)
Corresponding UI controls on pages 470 and 471 marked as Pending obsolete
Test codeunit 144017 guarded by CLEAN29 flag since it only exercises the deprecated field
No data migration needed as the field contains no meaningful data and is consumed nowhere
Field will be fully removed at CLEANSCHEMA32 after the Pending cycle completes
